source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol item 1: 'Label free - method optimization, comparing single and double digested FASP, IsD and IsG ... in replicates (12 raw files)'. MaxQuant Search_MethodOptimization_LF summary.txt experiments: F_LFQ_n_DD (Lys fraction 10/30, Trp 11/31), F_LFQ_n_SD, IsD_U_LFQ_DD_n, IsD_U_LFQ_SD_n, IsD_G_LFQ_DD_n; SDRF source names/factor values match. Per-run C-terminal residue statistics recomputed independently from deposited MaxQuant evidence.txt (unique non-decoy, non-contaminant sequences per raw file): Lys-C eluates (*_ddig_Lys*, DD_L_*) 92-97% K-terminal, 1.5-5% R-terminal, 30-56% internal uncleaved R; trypsin eluates (*_ddig_Trp, DD_T_*) 60-71% R-terminal with <1-8% internal K; single digests 40-51% R-terminal with low internal R; IsD-U double vs single digests show K-terminal share 59.5-60.7% vs 49.4-50.8% and internal K 13-15% vs 31-33%, consistent with added Lys-C; IsD-G runs are named Ddig/DD by the authors' MaxQuant experiments (IsD_G_LFQ_DD_*, IsD-G_SILAC_*_Ddig_*). SDRF rows: F_LFQ_*_ddig_Lys* = Lys-C; F_LFQ_*_ddig_Trp = Trypsin; *_sdig_trp and IsD_LFQ_sd_* = Trypsin; IsD_LFQ_dd_* and LF-1/LF-2 = Lys-C + Trypsin. All consistent.

findings.location: comment[cleavage agent details] rows for trypsin-eluate files (*_ddig_Trp / DD_T_*)
findings.message: Trypsin-eluate runs of the consecutive FASP double digestion are annotated with Trypsin only, although the material was pre-digested with Lys-C before the trypsin step.
findings.evidence: Trypsin eluates show 60-71% R-terminal peptides and <1-8% internal K (Lys sites already cut), consistent with Lys-C then trypsin; trypsin specificity [KR] still covers all termini, so reanalysis is unaffected. Correction criterion (optional): add Lys-C as a second cleavage agent for trypsin-eluate rows, or document the sequential scheme.

findings.message: Factor value has no mirroring characteristics/comment column.
findings.evidence: README 'Factor Values' rule: the factor value 'typically mirrors a characteristics column value' (SHOULD-level); sdrf-tools score Design 75/100 for this reason. Correction criterion: optionally add a matching characteristics/comment column (e.g. comment[sample preparation protocol]).
